summary: BiomX Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a corporate name change to Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc., effective September 11, 2026, following board approval on August 31, 2026. No stockholder vote is required under Delaware law. The common stock will trade under new ticker HLSQ on NYSE American, with CUSIP unchanged. This is a routine corporate action unrelated to any special-situation event such as merger, tender, or restructuring. The reverse stock split mentioned is separate and previously announced. No deal terms or transaction structure apply; regulatory filing with Delaware Secretary of State is expected.
